@@ -0,0 +1,160 @@
+"""
+Safe image loading utilities.
+
+Only decodes inline ``data:image/...;base64,...`` URLs and downloads objects
+from the configured storage service (either by relative storage key or by
+URL matching ``settings.STORAGE_HOST``). Any other network URL or unsafe path
+is rejected without making outbound requests.
+"""
+import base64
+import binascii
+import io
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from typing import Literal, Optional
+from urllib.parse import unquote, urlsplit
+
+from PIL import Image
+
+from app.core.config import settings
+from app.core.logging import get_logger
+from app.services.storage import storage
+
+logger = get_logger(__name__)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class _ResolvedImageSource:
+    kind: Literal["bytes", "storage"]
+    value: bytes | str
+
+
+def _is_safe_storage_key(key: str) -> bool:
+    """Validate that a relative storage object key has no traversal or control chars."""
+    if not key or key.startswith("/") or key.startswith("\\"):
+        return False
+    if any(ch in key for ch in ("\x00", "\\", "?", "#")):
+        return False
+    # Check both raw and percent-decoded segments for traversal.
+    for candidate in (key, unquote(key)):
+        if candidate.startswith("/") or "\\" in candidate or "\x00" in candidate:
+            return False
+        parts = candidate.split("/")
+        if any(part in ("", ".", "..") for part in parts):
+            return False
+    return True
+
+
+def _decode_data_image_url(value: str) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    """Decode a ``data:image/...;base64,...`` URL into raw bytes."""
+    header, sep, payload = value[5:].partition(",")
+    if not sep:
+        return None
+    parts = [part.strip().lower() for part in header.split(";") if part.strip()]
+    media_type = parts[0] if parts else ""
+    if not media_type.startswith("image/") or "base64" not in parts[1:]:
+        return None
+    clean_payload = "".join(payload.split())
+    if not clean_payload:
+        return None
+    try:
+        return base64.b64decode(clean_payload, validate=True)
+    except (binascii.Error, ValueError):
+        return None
+
+
+def _extract_storage_key_from_url(value: str) -> Optional[str]:
+    """Return the relative storage key if ``value`` points to ``settings.STORAGE_HOST``."""
+    storage_host = (settings.STORAGE_HOST or "").strip().rstrip("/")
+    if not storage_host:
+        return None
+
+    storage_parsed = urlsplit(storage_host)
+    if storage_parsed.scheme.lower() not in ("http", "https") or not storage_parsed.netloc:
+        return None
+    # Guard against the fallback "http://None/<bucket>" when MINIO_ENDPOINT is unset.
+    if not settings.MINIO_ENDPOINT and storage_parsed.hostname == "none":
+        return None
+
+    parsed = urlsplit(value)
+    if parsed.scheme.lower() != storage_parsed.scheme.lower():
+        return None
+    if parsed.netloc.lower() != storage_parsed.netloc.lower():
+        return None
+    if parsed.username is not None or parsed.password is not None:
+        return None
+    if parsed.query or parsed.fragment:
+        return None
+
+    storage_prefix = storage_parsed.path.rstrip("/")
+    expected_prefix = f"{storage_prefix}/" if storage_prefix else "/"
+    if not parsed.path.startswith(expected_prefix):
+        return None
+
+    raw_key = parsed.path[len(expected_prefix):]
+    if not _is_safe_storage_key(raw_key):
+        return None
+    return unquote(raw_key)
+
+
+def _resolve_image_source(url: Optional[str]) -> Optional[_ResolvedImageSource]:
+    """Classify and validate an image reference without performing I/O."""
+    if not url or not isinstance(url, str):
+        return None
+
+    value = url.strip()
+    if not value:
+        return None
+
+    if value.lower().startswith("data:"):
+        decoded = _decode_data_image_url(value)
+        if decoded is None:
+            logger.warning("Rejected invalid or non-image data URL")
+            return None
+        return _ResolvedImageSource(kind="bytes", value=decoded)
+
+    parsed = urlsplit(value)
+    if parsed.scheme or parsed.netloc:
+        storage_key = _extract_storage_key_from_url(value)
+        if storage_key is None:
+            logger.warning("Blocked disallowed image URL", scheme=parsed.scheme, host=parsed.hostname)
+            return None
+        return _ResolvedImageSource(kind="storage", value=storage_key)
+
+    if not _is_safe_storage_key(value):
+        logger.warning("Rejected unsafe relative image path")
+        return None
+    return _ResolvedImageSource(kind="storage", value=value)
+
+
+def is_allowed_image_url(url: Optional[str]) -> bool:
+    """Return True if ``url`` is an allowed image source (storage path/URL or image data URL)."""
+    return _resolve_image_source(url) is not None
+
+
+def load_image_bytes(url: Optional[str]) -> Optional[bytes]:
+    """Load image bytes from an allowed ``data:`` URL or configured storage."""
+    resolved = _resolve_image_source(url)
+    if resolved is None:
+        return None
+    if resolved.kind == "bytes":
+        assert isinstance(resolved.value, bytes)
+        return resolved.value
+    try:
+        assert isinstance(resolved.value, str)
+        return storage.download_image(resolved.value)
+    except Exception as e:
+        logger.warning("Failed to download image from storage", error=str(e))
+        return None
+
+
+def load_image_pil(url: Optional[str], mode: Optional[str] = None) -> Optional[Image.Image]:
+    """Load a PIL Image from an allowed ``data:`` URL or configured storage."""
+    img_bytes = load_image_bytes(url)
+    if not img_bytes:
+        return None
+    try:
+        img = Image.open(io.BytesIO(img_bytes))
+        return img.convert(mode) if mode else img
+    except Exception as e:
+        logger.warning("Failed to decode image bytes", error=str(e))
+        return None

+import base64
+import io
+import zipfile
+
+from app.services.storage import storage
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.lab_env import PNG
+
+
+def _create_episode(client, headers):
+    proj = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=headers, json={"title": "Missing Cuts", "genres": []})
+    assert proj.status_code == 200, proj.text
+    ep = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={"title": "Episode 1", "project_id": proj.json()["id"], "episode_order": 1, "story_summary": "s"},
+    )
+    assert ep.status_code == 200, ep.text
+    return ep.json()["id"]
+
+
+def _add_cut(client, headers, episode_id, order, image_path=None):
+    r = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/cuts",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={"episode_id": episode_id, "cut_order": order, "script": f"cut {order}", "image_path": image_path},
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()["id"]
+
+
+def test_export_without_missing_cuts_has_no_missing_txt_or_header(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    ep_id = _create_episode(client, h)
+    rel_key = storage.upload_image(PNG, schema="cuts", identifier="ok")
+    data_url = f"data:image/png;base64,{base64.b64encode(PNG).decode('ascii')}"
+
+    _add_cut(client, h, ep_id, 1, rel_key)
+    _add_cut(client, h, ep_id, 2, data_url)
+
+    zip_resp = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep_id}/export?format=zip", headers=h)
+    assert zip_resp.status_code == 200, zip_resp.text
+    assert "x-missing-cuts" not in {k.lower() for k in zip_resp.headers}
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(zip_resp.content), "r") as zf:
+        assert "missing.txt" not in zf.namelist()
+        assert len(zf.namelist()) == 2
+
+    strip_resp = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep_id}/export?format=webtoon", headers=h)
+    assert strip_resp.status_code == 200, strip_resp.text
+    assert "x-missing-cuts" not in {k.lower() for k in strip_resp.headers}
+
+
+def test_export_reports_missing_cuts_in_zip_and_header(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    ep_id = _create_episode(client, h)
+    valid_key = storage.upload_image(PNG, schema="cuts", identifier="valid")
+    corrupt_data_url = f"data:image/png;base64,{base64.b64encode(b'not-an-image').decode('ascii')}"
+
+    # Cut 1: valid storage image
+    _add_cut(client, h, ep_id, 1, valid_key)
+    # Cut 2: no image yet
+    _add_cut(client, h, ep_id, 2, None)
+    # Cut 3: refused internal URL
+    _add_cut(client, h, ep_id, 3, "http://127.0.0.1:9999/secret.png")
+    # Cut 4: missing object in storage (cannot be loaded)
+    _add_cut(client, h, ep_id, 4, "cuts/nonexistent/missing.png")
+    # Cut 5: valid storage image
+    _add_cut(client, h, ep_id, 5, valid_key)
+
+    zip_resp = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep_id}/export?format=zip", headers=h)
+    assert zip_resp.status_code == 200, zip_resp.text
+    assert zip_resp.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "2,3,4"
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(zip_resp.content), "r") as zf:
+        assert "missing.txt" in zf.namelist()
+        assert zf.read("missing.txt").decode("utf-8").splitlines() == ["2", "3", "4"]
+
+    # Add Cut 6 with corrupt image bytes (fails PIL load in webtoon strip)
+    _add_cut(client, h, ep_id, 6, corrupt_data_url)
+
+    strip_resp = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep_id}/export?format=webtoon", headers=h)
+    assert strip_resp.status_code == 200, strip_resp.text
+    assert strip_resp.headers["X-Missing-Cuts"] == "2,3,4,6"

+import base64
+import io
+import threading
+import zipfile
+from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer
+
+from PIL import Image
+
+from app.core.config import settings
+from app.services import reference_board
+from app.services.ai import ai_service
+from app.services.ai.base import BaseAIService
+from app.services.image_loader import is_allowed_image_url, load_image_bytes
+from app.services.storage import storage
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.lab_env import PNG
+
+
+def _start_trap_server():
+    """Start an HTTP server on 127.0.0.1 that records any incoming requests."""
+    hits: list[str] = []
+
+    class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
+        def do_GET(self):
+            hits.append(self.path)
+            self.send_response(200)
+            self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/plain")
+            self.end_headers()
+            self.wfile.write(b"INTERNAL_SECRET_DATA")
+
+        def log_message(self, format, *args):
+            pass
+
+    server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler)
+    thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
+    thread.start()
+    return server, hits
+
+
+def _setup_project_episode(client, headers):
+    proj = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=headers, json={"title": "SSRF Test", "genres": []})
+    assert proj.status_code == 200, proj.text
+    project_id = proj.json()["id"]
+
+    ep = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={"title": "Ep 1", "project_id": project_id, "episode_order": 1, "story_summary": "sum"},
+    )
+    assert ep.status_code == 200, ep.text
+    episode_id = ep.json()["id"]
+    return project_id, episode_id
+
+
+def _create_cut(client, headers, episode_id, order=1, image_path=None):
+    res = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/cuts",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={
+            "episode_id": episode_id,
+            "cut_order": order,
+            "script": "scene",
+            "image_path": image_path,
+        },
+    )
+    assert res.status_code == 200, res.text
+    return res.json()["id"]
+
+
+def test_export_zip_and_webtoon_never_request_internal_or_external_urls(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    _, episode_id = _setup_project_episode(client, h)
+    cut_id = _create_cut(client, h, episode_id, order=1)
+
+    server, hits = _start_trap_server()
+    try:
+        port = server.server_address[1]
+        malicious_urls = [
+            f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/secret",
+            f" http://127.0.0.1:{port}/padded",
+            f"http://localhost:{port}/secret",
+            f"http://[::1]:{port}/secret",
+            f"//127.0.0.1:{port}/protocol-relative",
+            "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/",
+            "http://10.0.0.1/internal.png",
+            "file:///etc/passwd",
+            f"{settings.STORAGE_HOST}/../secret.png",
+            "http://minio.invalid:9000/other-bucket/secret.png",
+        ]
+
+        for url in malicious_urls:
+            upd = client.put(f"/api/v1/cuts/{cut_id}", headers=h, json={"image_path": url})
+            assert upd.status_code == 200, upd.text
+
+            zip_resp = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format=zip", headers=h)
+            assert zip_resp.status_code == 400
+            assert b"INTERNAL_SECRET_DATA" not in zip_resp.content
+
+            strip_resp = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format=webtoon", headers=h)
+            assert strip_resp.status_code == 400
+            assert b"INTERNAL_SECRET_DATA" not in strip_resp.content
+
+        assert hits == []
+    finally:
+        server.shutdown()
+        server.server_close()
+
+
+def test_export_zip_and_webtoon_keep_working_for_storage_and_data_urls(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    _, episode_id = _setup_project_episode(client, h)
+
+    rel_key_1 = storage.upload_image(PNG, schema="cuts", identifier="cut1")
+    rel_key_2 = storage.upload_image(PNG, schema="cuts", identifier="cut2")
+    full_storage_url = f"{settings.STORAGE_HOST}/{rel_key_2}"
+    data_url = f"data:image/png;base64,{base64.b64encode(PNG).decode('ascii')}"
+
+    _create_cut(client, h, episode_id, order=1, image_path=rel_key_1)
+    cut2_id = _create_cut(client, h, episode_id, order=2)
+    upd = client.put(f"/api/v1/cuts/{cut2_id}", headers=h, json={"image_path": full_storage_url})
+    assert upd.status_code == 200, upd.text
+    _create_cut(client, h, episode_id, order=3, image_path=data_url)
+
+    zip_resp = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format=zip", headers=h)
+    assert zip_resp.status_code == 200, zip_resp.text
+    with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(zip_resp.content), "r") as zf:
+        names = sorted(zf.namelist())
+        assert len(names) == 3
+        for name in names:
+            assert zf.read(name) == PNG
+
+    strip_resp = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format=webtoon", headers=h)
+    assert strip_resp.status_code == 200, strip_resp.text
+    img = Image.open(io.BytesIO(strip_resp.content))
+    assert img.format == "PNG"
+
+
+def test_scenes_modify_blocks_internal_url_and_allows_storage_and_data_urls(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    project_id, _ = _setup_project_episode(client, h)
+    rel_key = storage.upload_image(PNG, schema="cuts", identifier="modify-src")
+    full_storage_url = f"{settings.STORAGE_HOST}/{rel_key}"
+    data_url = f"data:image/png;base64,{base64.b64encode(PNG).decode('ascii')}"
+
+    server, hits = _start_trap_server()
+    try:
+        port = server.server_address[1]
+        blocked = client.post(
+            "/api/v1/scenes/modify",
+            headers=h,
+            json={
+                "original_image_url": f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/secret",
+                "instruction": "make it darker",
+                "project_id": project_id,
+            },
+        )
+        assert blocked.status_code == 400
+        assert blocked.json()["code"] == "VALIDATION_INVALID_INPUT"
+        assert hits == []
+
+        for valid_url in (rel_key, full_storage_url, data_url):
+            ok = client.post(
+                "/api/v1/scenes/modify",
+                headers=h,
+                json={
+                    "original_image_url": valid_url,
+                    "instruction": "make it darker",
+                    "project_id": project_id,
+                },
+            )
+            assert ok.status_code == 200, ok.text
+            assert ok.json()["image_url"].startswith("data:image/png;base64,")
+    finally:
+        server.shutdown()
+        server.server_close()
+
+
+def test_ai_loaders_and_reference_board_block_network_urls_and_load_safe_sources():
+    rel_key = storage.upload_image(PNG, schema="characters", identifier="char1")
+    full_storage_url = f"{settings.STORAGE_HOST}/{rel_key}"
+    data_url = f"data:image/png;base64,{base64.b64encode(PNG).decode('ascii')}"
+
+    server, hits = _start_trap_server()
+    try:
+        port = server.server_address[1]
+        trap_url = f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/secret"
+
+        base = BaseAIService()
+        assert base._download_image(trap_url) is None
+        assert base._download_image_as_pil(trap_url) is None
+        assert reference_board.download_image(trap_url) is None
+
+        # Exercise AI service methods that load user-settable style/reference URLs
+        cover_bytes = ai_service.generate_project_cover_image(
+            title="Test",
+            genre="Fantasy",
+            worldview="World",
+            style="Webtoon",
+            style_ref_url=trap_url,
+            character_image_urls=[trap_url],
+        )
+        assert cover_bytes == PNG
+        assert hits == []
+
+        # Safe sources keep working
+        assert base._download_image(rel_key) == PNG
+        assert base._download_image(full_storage_url) == PNG
+        assert base._download_image(data_url) == PNG
+        assert reference_board.download_image(rel_key) is not None
+        assert reference_board.download_image(full_storage_url) is not None
+        assert reference_board.download_image(data_url) is not None
+    finally:
+        server.shutdown()
+        server.server_close()
+
+
+def test_image_loader_edge_cases():
+    assert not is_allowed_image_url(None)
+    assert not is_allowed_image_url("")
+    assert not is_allowed_image_url("   ")
+    assert not is_allowed_image_url("data:text/plain;base64,SGVsbG8=")
+    assert not is_allowed_image_url("data:image/png;base64,not-valid-base64!")
+    assert not is_allowed_image_url("/etc/passwd")
+    assert not is_allowed_image_url("../secret.png")
+    assert not is_allowed_image_url("cuts/../../secret.png")
+    assert not is_allowed_image_url("cuts/%2e%2e/secret.png")
+    assert not is_allowed_image_url("cuts\\secret.png")
+    assert not is_allowed_image_url(f"http://user:pass@minio.invalid:9000/toonify-prod-assets/cuts/1.png")
+    assert not is_allowed_image_url(f"{settings.STORAGE_HOST}/cuts/1.png?token=1")
+    assert not is_allowed_image_url(f"{settings.STORAGE_HOST}/cuts/1.png#frag")
+    assert load_image_bytes("http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/") is None
